items.q: How should I store Arabian Village olive oil?
items.a: Keep it in a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight and heat. Once opened, use within a few months for the best flavor.

items.q: What is the shelf life?
items.a: Unopened, the oil stays fresh for up to 18 months. The harvest date is printed on every label.

items.q: Is Arabian Village olive oil halal?
items.a: Yes. As a plant-based, alcohol-free product with no animal-derived ingredients, it is halal.

items.q: What does "acidity below 0.028%" mean?
items.a: It's a lab-tested purity measure — the lower the acidity, the fresher and higher-grade the extra virgin olive oil. Ours is well below the extra virgin threshold.

items.q: Can I use it for cooking, or only for dressing?
items.a: Both. First cold pressed extra virgin olive oil like ours is versatile — great for finishing dishes, salad dressings, dipping, and cooking at moderate temperatures.

items.q: Will there be more flavors or sizes available?
items.a: Yes — we're developing new harvests and formats. This product page will be updated as soon as they're ready.
